response.answer: Intrapartum antibiotic decisions and neonatal outcomes will be measured using clinical endpoints and health-economic analyses, with primary endpoints including neonatal morbidity and mortality. Time horizons will span from birth to one year post-delivery. Data sources will include hospital records and health service databases. Cost-benefit modeling requires inputs like treatment costs and health outcomes.
